rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for an adult woman.

example.jyutping: go2 go3 neoi5 jan4 zyu6 hai2 ngo5 gaak3 lei4

rows.note: Use this polite form when referring to a woman respectfully, especially in public or service contexts.

example.english: Woman with the red bag, please come with me.
example.traditional: 拎住紅袋嗰位女士，麻煩跟我嚟。
example.jyutping: ling1 zyu6 hung4 doi2 go2 wai2 neoi5 si6 maa4 faan4 gan1 ngo5 lei4

rows.note: Use this formal term for a woman as a member of the female population or in formal descriptions.

example.english: A woman in the workplace can still face unfair treatment.
example.traditional: 女性喺職場上仍然會遇到唔公平待遇。
example.jyutping: neoi5 sing3 hai2 zik1 coeng4 soeng6 jing4 jin4 wui5 jyu6 dou3 m4 gung1 ping4 doi6 jyu6
